# Evercraft Rewards

Product key: evercraft-rewards
Canonical product: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evercraft-rewards/index.html
Official MCP Registry: io.github.jgaethle10/evercraft-machine-commerce
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evercraft-rewards/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evercraft-rewards/ai-conformance.json

## Related product layers

- Evercraft Front Door: Fuel and other local utility surfaces can surface eligible nearby Rewards offers without making Rewards the canonical fuel data source.
- EventWave: Approved events can participate in event bonuses and local discovery while ticketing and attendance remain separate evidence states.
- Season & Story: Seasonal family activity and shopping contexts may surface approved Rewards opportunities without exposing private household data.
- Game Wallet: Evercraft Points can appear in the Game Wallet. Gaming redemption remains closed unless a funded authorized fulfillment rail exists.

## Authority

public read-only local reward discovery plus account-bound check-ins, Daily Prize Tickets and Game Wallet earning; Game Wallet fulfillment is implemented but production gaming issuance remains gated by provider authorization, credentials, sponsor funding and deployed-runtime verification; merchant enrollment is reversible and owner-confirmed through Evercraft Machine Commerce

## Boundaries

- read-only discovery creates no payment obligation
- a verified geofence check-in proves eligible proximity only and does not prove a purchase, transaction value, ticket purchase or event attendance
- Daily Prize Ticket selection, issuance, claim and credit state remain separate; ambiguous credit state requires reconciliation instead of automatic double payment
- Game Wallet fulfillment keeps reserve, debit intent, points debit, provider request, delivery, refund and reconciliation as separate evidence states
- a Giftbit adapter is implemented as provider adapter one; implementation does not imply provider partnership, production approval, funded inventory or live issuance
- gaming redemption remains unavailable until a specific funded and authorized fulfillment rail, provider credential, sponsor budget and deployed runtime are independently verified
- Evercraft Points are not represented as publisher currency, cash or a direct publisher partnership
- prepared merchant enrollment does not activate a merchant, offer, discount, public listing or payment obligation
- merchant directory publication and commercial activation require their own verified state
- following a Game Wallet destination records user intent only until a real configured reward offer supplies a points target
- referral attribution creates no automatic points or game credit
- a referral becomes qualified only after the invitee completes a verified local Rewards check-in; that qualification still does not prove a purchase
- merchant-funded Game Wallet earning boosts require a verified points-funding reference and capped points pool before activation

## Universal Evercraft routing

Not declared.

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
